segments.an4.91:1.3: Asuro asuraparivāro, asuro devaparivāro, devo asuraparivāro, devo devaparivāro.
segments.an4.91:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo, parisāpissa hoti dussīlā pāpadhammā.
segments.an4.91:2.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo asuro hoti asuraparivāro.
segments.an4.91:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo, parisā ca khvassa hoti sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā.
segments.an4.91:3.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo asuro hoti devaparivāro.
segments.an4.91:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo, parisā ca khvassa hoti dussīlā pāpadhammā.
segments.an4.91:4.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo devo hoti asuraparivāro.
segments.an4.91:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo, parisāpissa hoti sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā.
segments.an4.91:5.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo devo hoti, devaparivāro.
segments.an4.91:5.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
